description: SlyFox.bet is a live, free-to-play gaming prediction platform that turns game knowledge into competition. Players forecast release dates, review scores, announcements, and industry outcomes using virtual Coins, then build a record through accuracy, winnings, streaks, and leaderboards.

I led Sly Fox from concept and product strategy through brand, UX, design systems, architecture, data modeling, integrations, testing, and launch. Built fully using AI-assisted workflows extended my reach across disciplines and accelerated research, implementation, and iteration, while I retained ownership of every product decision and the overall quality bar.

The focused player experience is backed by a complete operational platform: dynamic odds, evidence-based resolution, external game and review data, ledger-backed accounts, content workflows, scheduled automation, and administrative safeguards. That depth allows Sly Fox to operate as a living product, with the systems needed to keep markets timely, explainable, and trustworthy.
overview.deliverables: Product Direction, Brand & UX, Design Systems, Full-Stack Engineering, Data Architecture, Content Operations, Automation & AI Workflows

sections.title: From onboarding to activation
description: Invite-based onboarding establishes the value proposition immediately: turn what you know about games into something you can prove.
It also creates a controlled path for growth, helping manage demand and platform load while building anticipation as the community scales.

sections.title: A market built for confident decisions
sections.description: Dynamic odds, potential winnings, game context, activity, timing, and published resolution rules give players the context to make an informed call.

sections.title: The complete journey, on any screen
sections.description: The responsive experience carries players from discovery through decision and confirmation without sacrificing context or capability.

sections.title: Competition built around skill
sections.description: Multiple rankings reward wins, accuracy, streaks, and Coin performance—giving different kinds of players a meaningful way to compete.

sections.title: Operations are part of the product
sections.description: The administration platform turns prediction authoring, market configuration, resolution rules, editorial content, and live previews into a controlled workflow.

sections.title: Automation behind every market
sections.description: Observable pipelines synchronize game data, generate and close predictions, collect review information, resolve outcomes, and reconcile accounts—with human intervention when needed.
